semiconductor_relevance: Medium — PROSOL JAPAN is involved in the maintenance and repair of turbomolecular pumps, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: PROSOL JAPAN specializes in the maintenance and repair of turbomolecular pumps and controllers, serving various manufacturers and models. They focus on enhancing the reliability and efficiency of these pumps, which are essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Maintenance and repair of turbomolecular pumps
Development of unique technologies for pump efficiency

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Omuta City, Fukuoka Prefecture, with a focus on supporting Japanese manufacturing.
